subject: POC trial environment: hosted vs dedicated sandbox vs VPC - next steps
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeai.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmeai.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Discovery call recap & POC options

Hi Alex / Priya —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and proposed next steps for the POC/trial so we’re aligned before kickoff: 

Summary of needs (from our notes):
- Use case: customer support categorization + response ranking for Acme AI Support bot
- Data: ~200k historical support tickets (SaaS), attachments limited to PDFs/images, no HIPAA data
- Performance targets: <200ms median latency for single-threaded queries, throughput ~50 QPS peak during business hours
- Security: must be able to isolate data and control keys; preference to avoid sending PII to third parties without controls

Suggested POC options (pros/cons):
1) Hosted trial (fastest) — Redwood hosted API with tenant isolation. Best for fast validation (1-2 weeks).
2) Dedicated sandbox — reserved capacity (GPU pool) in our infra; predictable throughput, better isolation; ideal if you want sustained load testing (2-3 weeks to provision).
3) VPC trial (private deployment) — Private control plane/VPC peering or on-prem connector for strict network isolation (3-4+ weeks prep; good for security review).

Success criteria / evaluation plan:
- Latency: median and p95 under your SLAs with production-like prompts
- Quality: reranking precision >= your baseline (we’ll run a 500-sample eval set)
- Cost: token cost per request within target range (we’ll estimate via sample runs)
- Ops: ability to integrate logs/tracing into your existing observability pipeline

Proposed timeline (flexible):
- Week 0: finalize scope + sign mutual action plan (MAP)
- Week 1: hosted trial standing up (or start provisioning dedicated sandbox)
- Week 2: ingest sample dataset + run evals
- Week 3: performance/runbook handoff + decision point for next phase (scale / VPC)

Ownership: 
- Marissa (me) — commercial lead / MAP and timeline owner
- Dev Patel — technical lead (env setup, sample ingestion, eval harness)
- Monica Patel — CS lead / success criteria tracking and documentation

Attached is a POC template I filled out with a suggested scope and timeline: [Attachment: redwood_poc_template.xlsx].

Please confirm which environment you prefer to start with (hosted / dedicated sandbox / VPC) and any constraints we should know about (data residency, procurement timelines, security questionnaire deadlines). I’ll loop in the right folks and send a calendar invite for a kickoff.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
[Attachment: redwood_poc_template.xlsx]

From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeai.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmeai.com>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-11T10:05:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Discovery call recap & POC options

Thanks Marissa — super helpful summary. A couple quick follow-ups from our side: 

1) Data residency: we’d prefer US-only hosting for this initial POC. If hosted trial can guarantee US region only, that’s preferred.
2) Isolation: we have to ensure logs and transcripts are not shared across tenants; is the hosted trial tenant-isolated at rest?
3) If the dedicated sandbox is marginally slower to provision but gives stronger isolation, we may prefer that — depends on procurement timing.

Our timeline: we want a decision point within 3 weeks; procurement lead (Priya) can push for a sandbox if needed.

For now let’s start with the hosted trial if you can confirm region/isolation, and we’ll pivot to a dedicated sandbox if procurement requires.

Also can Dev confirm expected rate limits for the hosted trial (burst/steady)?

Appreciate it — Alex
Alex Johnson
Director of Product, Acme AI
alex.johnson@acmeai.com

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeai.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmeai.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-12T09:20:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Discovery call recap & POC options - tech notes

Hi all —

Quick technical notes / recommendations from engineering: 
- Hosted trial: we can provision a US-region tenant and ensure tenant-level data isolation for logs and storage. We treat each customer namespace separately; logs can be forwarded to your observability but we can redact or not retain by default per agreement.
- Default hosted trial limits: 100 QPS burst up to 200 QPS for short bursts, steady-state 50 QPS. Those are configurable for a trial but will depend on model choice/sequence length.
- Dedicated sandbox: we can reserve a GPU pool and give you network-level isolation; good for sustained throughput testing and pen tests. Provisioning typically takes 5-10 business days once order is in.
- VPC trial: requires network setup and security review (we’ll need firewall/IP allowlists and a short connectivity test). Plan 3-4 weeks for full VPC peering + onboarding.

Questions for Acme:
- What model-size profile do you want us to configure for the trial (short-list: small/medium/large)? Helps size the sandbox.
- Can you share a sample of the 500 eval prompts and one-week production traffic trace (anonymized)?

I attached a short doc that summarizes environment options and typical lead times.

Thanks — I’ll standby to provision a US-hosted tenant immediately once we get the go-ahead.

Dev Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: trial_env_options.pdf]

From: Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmeai.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeai.com>
Date: 2026-11-13T11:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Discovery call recap & POC options - data/traffic details

Thanks Dev — and thanks Marissa. Quick answers from our infra team: 
- Expected steady-state traffic: ~40 QPS during business hours; peaks up to ~120 QPS during incident spikes (rare).
- Typical request size: average 1.2k tokens in + 256 tokens out.
- Dataset for eval: we can export a 500-sample eval set and a 7-day anonymized traffic trace by EOD Friday.
- Region: confirmed US only for now.

We’re comfortable starting with the hosted trial as long as you can guarantee US-region only and tenant-level isolation for logs. If procurement requires stronger contractual controls we’ll move to a dedicated sandbox, but we want to iterate quickly first.

Priya Shah
Procurement Lead, Acme AI
priya.shah@acmeai.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@acmeai.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@acmeai.com>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-15T09:30:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Discovery call recap & POC options - confirmed next steps

Perfect — thanks everyone for the quick responses. Confirming next steps and owners: 

- Action: Stand up US-hosted trial tenant (tenant-isolated, logs retention configurable)
  Owner: Dev Patel (technical lead)
  Target: provisioned by 2026-11-17 (2 business days)

- Action: Acme to share 500-sample eval set + 7-day anonymized trace
  Owner: Priya (Acme)
  Target: 2026-11-20

- Action: Run baseline quality eval and performance run
  Owner: Dev + Monica (runbook + eval harness)
  Target: results by 2026-11-24

- Decision point: internal sync to decide whether to continue on hosted, or request dedicated sandbox / VPC
  Owner: Alex + Marissa
  Target: 2026-11-30

I’ve created a HubSpot MAP and a kickoff calendar invite (links below). I’ll also add a short runbook template to the shared Drive folder so Monica can track success criteria.

Thanks —
